candidates.title: Corpus-wide audit sidecar drift: pinned outputs and dataset digests vs live tree
candidates.gap: 4,315 committed `*.measurements.yaml` sidecars record `outputs[].sha256` and `provenance.input_dataset_sha256`, but there is no closed-loop check that those pins still match `docs/media/` artifacts and `datasets/` files on a fresh checkout. A 2026-10-27 scan of all sidecars found 381 output paths missing on disk across 308 audit ids, 38 live artifact SHA-256 mismatches, and 117 live input-dataset digest mismatches across 91 audit ids (including flagship early audits whose sidecars reference root-level GIF/PNG names that are absent from `docs/media/`).
candidates.done: A batch report (new JSON under `morphoeval/runs/`, not committed sidecars) lists every audit id where either (a) `python3 morphoeval/measure_outputs.py <audit.yaml>` prints a non-empty `missing` list, or (b) recomputed `input_dataset_sha256` differs from the committed sidecar for any keyed path. Done when the report exists and its totals are reproducible from the commands below (same counts on re-run).
candidates.tool_route: for f in morphoeval/audits/*.yaml; do python3 morphoeval/measure_outputs.py "$f"; done — diff stdout `missing` lines and regenerated `*.measurements.yaml` `provenance` blocks against the committed sidecar beside each audit.
candidates.deciding_data: In repo: `morphoeval/audits/*.yaml`, `morphoeval/audits/*.measurements.yaml`, `docs/media/*`, `datasets/**` referenced in sidecar provenance.
candidates.prior_attempts: Individual KG `REPORT.md` files cite `artifact_sha256` for published bundles, but no swarm task closes a corpus-wide stale-sidecar inventory; not listed in `docs/open-problems.json`.

tool_fit.why: `measure_outputs.py` is the authoritative regenerator of sidecar fingerprints and explicitly emits `missing` rather than inventing hashes.

data_in_hand.why: All audits, sidecars, datasets, and media paths are already in the repository; no external fetch required.

falsifiable_done.why: Verdict is a finite list of audit ids and paths with boolean pass/fail per audit, checkable by diffing digests.

compute_in_repo.why: Thousands of audit YAMLs make a full batch CPU-heavy but embarrassingly parallel and bounded to hours on the cloud VM stack.

isolation.why: Read-only measurement pass; closure is a new report file without editing tracked audits.

time_to_verdict.why: Full corpus pass may exceed one sitting; a stratified 200-audit sample already yields a decisive non-zero drift signal.

not_blocked.why: No prior attempt refuted re-measurement as a drift detector; gap is execution, not methodology.

candidates.title: Self-referential morphometric anchors inflating quick_gate baseline scores
candidates.gap: `measure_outputs.py` `compute_quick_gate` awards baseline credit whenever `reference_value` is non-null, without checking external provenance. A parse of all 4,315 sidecars found 1,089 measurements with `value == reference_value` (exact float match). Audits already flag exemplars (e.g. tracheal viscous fingering v3: `*_obs` columns in `tracheal_viscous_fingering_reference.json` fitted to model outputs; Levin YouTube v2: 23/25 laws with `reference_value == value` by construction), but there is no machine-readable census tying sidecar measurements back to independent literature or specimen digests.
candidates.done: A report enumerates, per audit id, counts of measurements with `|value - reference_value| < 1e-6` whose `reference_source` lacks allowlisted tokens (`self-consistency`, `parity`, `script`, `generated`). For tracheal v3, done additionally requires re-run measurements for Pearson-r laws show `reference_source` citing Nelson 2017 figure coordinates OR the count of exact-match refs sourced only from `*_obs` JSON columns is zero.
candidates.tool_route: python3 morphoeval/measure_outputs.py morphoeval/audits/2026-10-19-tracheal-viscous-fingering-audit-v3.yaml; plus offline parse of all `morphoeval/audits/*.measurements.yaml` measurement blocks (no LLM).
candidates.deciding_data: In repo: sidecars, `datasets/tracheal_viscous_fingering/tracheal_viscous_fingering_reference.json`, audit v3 YAML remediation bullets; Levin audit v2 sidecar comment header.
candidates.prior_attempts: Tracheal v3 and Levin v2/v3 referee passes documented self-referential refs in prose; no automated scorer output committed.
